confirmation_holdout.limitation: not pristine: earlier phases evaluated parts of it
confirmation_holdout.name: Phase-10B confirmation holdout
confirmation_holdout.rule: evaluated only for development qualifiers, only with --confirm, each exactly once; with no qualifier it is never read

evaluation.confirmation_rule: CONFIRMED iff QUALIFIED in development AND on the holdout

development_period.rule: frame cut at the end BEFORE targets are built: the last h rows are unlabelled and no AAPL/SPY close after the end is used

gate.classification: log loss < Base Rate log loss AND one-sided DM p < significance AND accuracy >= Always UP accuracy
gate.dm: one-sided Diebold-Mariano, Newey-West variance with horizon - 1 lags
gate.regression: MSE < min(MSE of Mean Return, Zero Return) AND one-sided DM p < significance

evaluation.holdout_procedure: labelled holdout rows in 20 contiguous folds; expanding-window training on all earlier rows minus a gap of `horizon` rows; same metrics and gate_v1 (Phase 9 procedure)
evaluation.row_selection: Phase 9 research frame (Phase 8 store rows covered by every family incl. the 20-session sentiment window and strict market context); identical rows for every feature set
evaluation.tuning: none - every parameter fixed in this matrix

f_duplicate_resolution.nature: representation hygiene, decided before any Phase 10A result; Phase 9 artifacts unchanged
f_duplicate_resolution.reason: both count AAPL articles with ts(prev session) < information_available_at <= ts(D) (identical on every Phase 9 research row); the retained column is the verified Phase 6/8 event feature, so the events family is identical in C, D and F; sw_count_surprise_1_20 keeps using the same 1-session count

feature_definitions.sentiment_window: sentiment_window_v1 (Phase 9, unchanged) without sw_count_1 in F

matrix.hypothesis: a volatility-normalized excess target may be more learnable (to be tested, not assumed)
leakage_rules: prediction timestamp D 16:30 America/New_York; features use information_available_at <= it
market features: AAPL/SPY/QQQ bars dated <= D only
news/sentiment/events: verified Phase 8 records with the established conservative availability
future AAPL and SPY closes: target construction only
no forward fill, interpolation or normalization with future values
development frame cut at the development end before targets are built
no confirmation-period target distribution is inspected
volatility denominator: closes dated <= D only; never a feature
matrix.research_question: Does normalizing AAPL's future excess return relative to SPY by prediction-time realized volatility improve out-of-sample predictive performance?
